Name: (CP)(XNB) Cute opossum pet Retexture
Author: baristarulesgood
Description:
The opossum in Stardew Valley was cute, so I trimmed it and made it into a pet !
I like the way opossum🐭 freeze when they were surprise, so I drew it and it's my favorite

[CP] Mode is added as a pet
you can get from marnie's shop

[xnb]It's a cat Retexture file
Please change the file name to cat.xnb and put it in this path >> Stardew Valley\Content\Animals
You can replace Existing cat.xnb file !

I'm sorry for my poor English

** Special thanks to PashaWithHat for the mode ! **
